capabilities: Sync the whole vault to Confluence as nested pages under a root page
Convert wiki links, embeds, callouts, and code blocks to Confluence links and macros
Update only changed pages incrementally while preserving version history
Find and review orphaned Confluence pages left by earlier syncs
View sync status, logs, and repair a stale page-mapping cache
extras: Not yet in the official Community Plugins directory; install via BRAT or manual download. The sync is one-way: it never modifies or deletes vault files, and page cleanup happens only on the Confluence side. Images embed as links; image upload is not yet supported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish a vault to Confluence, so moving notes there means manually recreating page trees and rewriting wiki links, callouts, and code blocks.

relations.evidence: Push an entire Obsidian vault into a custom Confluence parent page using Confluence REST API.

summary: One-way exporter that pushes an entire Obsidian vault to Confluence as a nested page hierarchy, converting wiki links, callouts, and code blocks.
